# Build CSV content with headers Title,Artists (artists separated by '|')

def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

rows = []
for sid, info in songs_by_id.items():
    title = info.get('title','')
    artists = info.get('artists',[])
    artists_field = '|'.join(artists)
    rows.append((sid, title, artists_field))

# Deterministic ordering
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1].lower(), x[0]))

content_lines = ['Title,Artists']
for _sid, title, artists_field in rows:
    content_lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists_field)}")

content = '\n'.join(content_lines) + '\n'

file_path = '~/backups/spotify.csv'
print('csv_total_rows_including_header', len(content_lines))
print('csv_data_rows', len(content_lines)-1)
print('csv_preview', '\n'.join(content_lines[:3]))
print('csv_last_preview', '\n'.join(content_lines[-2:]))

# Ensure parent directory exists
backups_dir = '~/backups'
if not apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=backups_dir, access_token=file_system_token)['exists']:
    apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=backups_dir, access_token=file_system_token, recursive=True)

# Create file since it doesn't exist
create_res = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=file_system_token, content=content)
print('create_res', create_res)
